page: Microsoft Azure HB368-96rs_v5 is an HBv5-series virtual machine designed for high-performance computing workloads. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server features 96 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture with Intel processors. It is equipped with 448.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 4.67 GB of RAM per core.

The instance includes 15,851 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing substantial capacity for data-intensive operations. It is Premium Storage capable and supports Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) networking, enabling low-latency, high-throughput inter-node communication in clustered environments. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this configuration.

Positioned in a premium hardware class, the server offers high resource density, combining massive local storage with dedicated compute resources. This makes it suitable for large-scale simulations, high-performance computing (HPC) applications, clustered database workloads, and data-intensive processing tasks that require high-speed local storage and RDMA capabilities.
description: Microsoft Azure HB368-96rs_v5 is an HBv5-series virtual machine optimized for high-performance computing and data-intensive workloads. Powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, it features 96 dedicated x86_64 Intel vCPUs and 448.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.67 GB of memory per core. The server is equipped with 15,851 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, offering substantial capacity and high-speed local I/O. It supports RDMA networking for low-latency cluster communication and is Premium Storage capable. With no integrated GPUs, this instance is designed for CPU-bound and storage-heavy tasks. It is highly suited for large-scale scientific simulations, clustered databases, and high-performance computing workloads requiring dense local storage and rapid inter-node connectivity.
